# AI Act Disclosure Desk

AI Act Disclosure Desk maintains AI feature inventory, user touchpoints, disclosure text versions, reviewer signoff, and Article 50 evidence exports.

Website: https://aiactdisclosuredesk.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: EU AI Act disclosure evidence
Type: SaaS
Default plan: Team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
